QuestInfo.name: [Home] A Nice Place to Sit
QuestInfo.0: Alvin has prepared a little housewarming gift for you to welcome you to the neighborhood. Speak with Alvin.
QuestInfo.1:
Alvin gave you a soft #t2672015:# to welcome you to the neighborhood. Why don't you place it next to your bed?

#b#e[Tip: Placing Furnishings]#n
1. Double-click a furnishing item in your inventory to transfer it to the [Furnishing Storage].
2. Click #i3801391# button in the Home menu to open [Furnishing Storage].
3. Double-click the furnishing you want to place or click the [Place] button while it's highlighted.
4. After clicking the location where you want to place the furnishing, click the [Confirm Placement] button.
